## Event photography

- Page: https://ayoubabed.xyz/services/event-portraits/
- Starting prices: $400 for 1 hour, $550 for 2 hours, $700 for 3 hours, $850 for 4 hours, plus $150 for each extra hour
- Who: Ayoub Abedrabbo, event photographer in Tampa, Florida
- Area: within 30 miles of Tampa, Florida. Travel within 30 miles of Tampa is included.
- Event photography for the booking. Portrait sessions are included.
- Gallery: each photo shows up within minutes of being taken.
- Guests do not pay. The host books and pays.
- No backdrop, no flash, and no lighting kit.
- Videography: custom quote. No published video prices.
- Email: Ayoub@AyoubAbed.xyz
- Phone: (813) 424-0606
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/7r3JFHfe32ubHtKa7

### How to inquire

Send coverage length, extra time, event date, venue, city, guest count, event type, name, phone, and email to [Ayoub@AyoubAbed.xyz](mailto:Ayoub@AyoubAbed.xyz). The page form opens an email draft with these fields. Sending it does not reserve the date; Ayoub replies to confirm availability.
